steps: Pause all traffic to checkout-service to prevent further user impact.
Collect detailed metrics and logs from checkout-service for the last 30 minutes.
Run a canary deployment of checkout-service v2.4.0 on a single replica and route 5% of traffic to it.
Compare canary metrics with current production metrics to confirm regression.
If canary confirms regression, initiate a controlled rollback of checkout-service to v2.4.0 across all replicas.
Verify recovery by running verify_recovery and ensuring checkout-service meets health checks.
Document findings and update incident log with evidence of regression and rollback steps.
Escalate to platform owners with compiled evidence if rollback cannot be performed safely.
